baseline_workbook: Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
research_scope: First-party Singapore online pickup menu. Exact outlet selection and address crosswalk; 80 published menu items/prices for one outlet. Excluded vouchers, Plain White Rice and Grouper (shown unavailable). No delivery marketplace sources used.

outlets.branch_crosswalk: Exact SFA licence CE13571N000 and postal code 059413 match Public F&B Directory. First-party source page selected outlet is Segar @ Chinatown at 133 New Bridge Road #B2-39/40/41, Chinatown Point, Singapore 059413; matches directory street, units and postal code.
outlets.menu_page_observation: Fetched first-party official ordering page 2026-10-19 05:49 SGT; HTTP Date 2026-10-18 21:49:44 GMT. Page shows Segar @ Chinatown selected and pickup address. Named menu categories show published item names and SGD pickup prices.
outlets.confidence: High for menu page branch selection, outlet crosswalk, published item names and listed prices; medium for order-time availability because inventory is dynamic.
